I maintain Severity 3 as it doesn't compromise the whole object, but it is a significant structural flaw.

New Observation: The 'mirror' surface inside the door lacks true reflectivity. It appears as a flat grey gradient rather than reflecting the interior of the cabinet or the room. This is a subtle material artifact (Severity 2) that the Router missed, contributing to the 'uncanny' feel of the interior.
